translations.web: They will bear their shame, and all their trespasses by which they have trespassed against me, when they dwell securely in their land, and no one will make them afraid,
translations.bsb: They will forget their disgrace and all the treachery they committed against Me, when they dwell securely in their land, with no one to frighten them.
translations.kjv: After that they have borne their shame, and all their trespasses whereby they have trespassed against me, when they dwelt safely in their land, and none made them afraid.
translations.asv: And they shall bear their shame, and all their trespasses whereby they have trespassed against me, when they shall dwell securely in their land, and none shall make them afraid;
